name: SDN-AP Propagator
description: General-perturbations propagation of whole catalogs in one WASM module. Theories: SGP4 (STR#3 / Vallado 2006) and SGP4XP (the US Space Force SGP4-XP theory, clean-room from the public change list and the black-box specification), and AP, an advanced propagator that builds on the entire history of astrodynamics. Element sets are $OCM records, each the whole input of its flight: theory, forces, daily space weather, density-correction nodes and covariance typed; the propagator ABI struct path (plugin_init_omm) flies stock SGP4XP only. Propagator ABI exports (plugin_init_omm, plugin_propagate, plugin_propagate_batch, plugin_entity_count, plugin_destroy; Earth-fixed meters) and a structure-of-arrays batch entry (sdnap_*; TEME or Earth-fixed). Bounded checkpoint storage per object; cached brackets interpolate, first queries build nodes, and beyond-span queries integrate from the nearest preceding retained node. An AP state is a function of its set and its time alone: the order of requests, the call they come in and the sets flown between them leave its bits unchanged (SPEC 9; test/set-caches.e2e.mjs). A store's AP sets keep their own caches and node runs from one pool (256 MB; sdnap_cache_stats reads it); sets beyond it fly on the thread's caches with the same states. Cost and memory by request pattern: README, Memory and time (test/kernel-patterns.mjs).

methods.description: The one $OMM boundary: each Space-Track or CelesTrak $OMM (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4 or SGP4XP; for SGP4XP, BTERM and AGOM, both m^2/kg, from the $OMM's BTERM and AGOM fields, or, with neither set, from BSTAR and MEAN_MOTION_DDOT by the SGP4-XP element-set definition; HEADER.COMMENT states the source, BTERM_SOURCE=BTERM AGOM_SOURCE=AGOM or BTERM_SOURCE=BSTAR AGOM_SOURCE=MEAN_MOTION_DDOT) becomes one $OCM on 'ocm' with its theory's own forces written explicitly (SGP4: GRAVITY_MODEL WGS-72, WEATHER_SOURCE NONE, no ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL, both caps 0, ORB_AVERAGING KOZAI; SGP4XP: ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL {JXX,1970}, WEATHER_SOURCE THEORY_FLUX_MODEL, DENSITY_CORRECTION NONE, both caps 0, GRAVITY_MODEL EGM-96, ORB_AVERAGING BROUWER), NORAD_CAT_ID, the identity, ORIGINATOR and the $OMM's PROVENANCE; the sets also replace the module's element set for the propagator ABI exports and the sdnap_* batch entry. Refused by name: missing-omm, invalid-omm, unsupported-center, user-defined-parameters:<count> (an $OMM with USER_DEFINED_PARAMETERS, by their count, never read by name), theory-not-ingestable:AP.

methods.description: Each $OCM element set (SGP4, SGP4XP or AP), plain or size-prefixed, flown under the forces its record states to one $OEM, km and km/s, UTC, at the $PCF OUTPUT times (EPOCHS, or START_TIME to STOP_TIME at STEP_SECONDS; defaults: the set's epoch, one day later, 60 s) in OUTPUT.FRAME (TEME by default; GCRF or EME2000), with one covariance line per state when the set carries COVARIANCE_DATA; at most OUTPUT.MAXIMUM_STATES states per request. Flight takes $OCM records and an optional $PCF and nothing else: a lone $OCM flies. The record is the whole input of the set: MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY alone names the theory (SGP4: BSTAR, MEAN_MOTION_DOT, MEAN_MOTION_DDOT, BTERM = AGOM = 0; SGP4XP and AP: BTERM, AGOM, BSTAR = MEAN_MOTION_DOT = MEAN_MOTION_DDOT = 0), ORB_AVERAGING KOZAI or BROUWER to match, TRAJ_REF_FRAME TEMEOFDATE, or TEMEOFEPOCH with TRAJ_FRAME_EPOCH the set's EPOCH for AP with a gravity cap above 0; PERTURBATIONS states the forces: WEATHER_SOURCE always (SGP4: NONE), ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL exactly when it is not NONE, {JXX,1970} or {NRLMSIS00E,2000}; SGP4XP is Jacchia 1970 on the theory's flux model with no correction and both caps 0, AP any other; RECORDS flies on the record's SPACE_WEATHER (one row a UTC day, ascending: on day d F10.7 of day d - 1, F10.7a and Ap of day d), from the day after its first row to the end of its last and no further; DCA_COMMON_MODE on its DENSITY_CORRECTION_NODE_TIMES_MS and _LOG_DENSITY_SCALE_DIMENSIONLESS over {NRLMSIS00E,2000}, with DENSITY_CORRECTION_CID; COVARIANCE_DATA with COV_PARAMETER_KINDS and COV_PROPAGATION carries the covariance (SPEC 12). methods.displayName: Fit OEM to an SGP4XP or AP $OCM
methods.description: Fits an element set to each $OEM ephemeris block and writes it as one $OCM: the six mean elements, BTERM and AGOM (Levenberg-Marquardt on TEME position residuals with analytic Jacobians for the elements and BTERM and a theory difference for AGOM, a log-normal prior on BTERM (FIT.DRAG_PRIOR unset: median 0.01 m^2/kg, sigma of the log ln 10; the fit steps in ln BTERM, so BTERM stays above 0) and a weak prior on AGOM about zero). The $PCF FORCES are the force model the fit runs under and the record states: ATMOSPHERE_MODEL, required, JACCHIA70 or NRLMSISE00; WEATHER_SOURCE THEORY_FLUX_MODEL (JACCHIA70 only) or RECORDS (UNSPECIFIED: THEORY_FLUX_MODEL under JACCHIA70, RECORDS under NRLMSISE00); DENSITY_CORRECTION NONE or DCA_COMMON_MODE (NRLMSISE00, a 'density_correction' $DCL); MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE and MAXIMUM_DEGREE (the zonal tail), 0 to 70; WEATHER_EXTENSION UNSPECIFIED or REFUSE; every other FORCES field away from its default is refused by name, ENABLE_DRAG included (configuration-refused FORCES.ENABLE_DRAG). JACCHIA70 on THEORY_FLUX_MODEL with no correction and no terms is SGP4XP (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY SGP4XP, the elements rounded to the two-line text's digits and searched on their lattice); any other force model is AP (MEAN_ELEMENT_THEORY AP, full precision); THEORY SGP4XP or AP must agree with the forces, UNSPECIFIED takes theirs. The arc grown from two revolutions by threes to the fit interval; the interval ends at the block's USEABLE_STOP_TIME or FIT.HOLDOUT_HOURS before the data (later states held out and scored) and starts at USEABLE_START_TIME; without it the span rule (DESIGN 2e.3, $PCF FIT): FIT.DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS (48 h; ECCENTRIC_DEFAULT_SPAN_HOURS 24 h above ECCENTRICITY_THRESHOLD 0.5), each candidate span fitted to the data before the latest TAIL_HOURS and scored on that tail, a longer one kept only when its tail error is within EXTENSION_MARGIN (0.9; eccentric 0.7) of the best shorter one's; a fit RMS beyond FIT.IMPLAUSIBLE_RMS_KM (100 km) is refused (fit-implausible). The $OCM: MEAN_ELEMENTS (EPOCH the first state of the fit interval, Brouwer MEAN_MOTION, BTERM, AGOM; BSTAR, MEAN_MOTION_DOT and MEAN_MOTION_DDOT 0); METADATA NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_NAME and INTERNATIONAL_DESIGNATOR from the block's OBJECT (CATALOG_NAME NORAD, OBJECT_DESIGNATOR the number), TIME_SYSTEM UTC; HEADER.ORIGINATOR the $OEM's; CENTER_NAME EARTH; TRAJ_REF_FRAME TEMEOFDATE, or TEMEOFEPOCH with TRAJ_FRAME_EPOCH the set's epoch when a gravity cap is above 0; ORB_AVERAGING BROUWER; STATE_DATA empty; PERTURBATIONS ATMOSPHERIC_MODEL {JXX,1970} or {NRLMSIS00E,2000}, GRAVITY_MODEL EGM-96, MAXIMUM_TESSERAL_DEGREE, MAXIMUM_ZONAL_DEGREE, WEATHER_SOURCE, DENSITY_CORRECTION; under RECORDS SPACE_WEATHER, one $SPW row (DATE, F107_OBS, F107_OBS_CENTER81, AP_AVG, F107_DATA_TYPE) per UTC day from the day before the fit arc's first day through the later of its last day and the epoch's day plus FIT.WEATHER_HORIZON_DAYS (30), with SW_DATA_SOURCE (the rows' PVN.SOURCE_ID), SW_DATA_EPOCH (the last observed row) and SW_INTERP_METHOD; under DCA_COMMON_MODE the $DCL's nodes from the last at or before the first row's day through the last published, and DENSITY_CORRECTION_CID; ORBIT_DETERMINATION OD_ESTIMATOR BatchLeastSquares, OD_METHOD, OD_ALGORITHM, OD_EPOCH, OD_OBSERVATIONS_USED, OD_EST_PARAMETERS, ACTUAL_OD_SPAN, DAYS_SINCE_FIRST_OBS and DAYS_SINCE_LAST_OBS when not negative, OD_DYNAMIC_PARAMETERS DRAG_AREA_OVER_MASS and SRP_AREA_OVER_MASS (VALUE BTERM and AGOM, SOLVED_FOR), FIT_STATISTICS (the arc FIT_START to FIT_STOP, states, RMS, largest, radial, in-track and cross-track RMS, iterations, convergence, the held-out stop, states, RMS, largest and RMS by day, the $PCF's CID); PROVENANCE this module (PROVIDER_ID and PRODUCER), or, with a 'provenance' $PVN for the ephemeris, that PVN field for field (SOURCE_ID, SOURCE_KIND, ORIGINATOR, PROVIDER_ID, LICENSE_CLASS, LICENSE_ID, LINEAGE, SOURCE_URL, SOURCE_VERSION, RETRIEVED_AT, SOURCE_SHA256, SOURCE_BYTES) with PRODUCER this module and version. The block's frame is read from its REFERENCE_FRAME, never assumed: TEME, GCRF or ICRF, EME2000 or J2000 and Earth-fixed (ITRF, ECEF, WGS84), time system UTC; a block centered elsewhere than the Earth is refused (unsupported-center). Plain or size-prefixed $OEM. Refused by name: configuration-missing, invalid-configuration, configuration-refused, missing-oem, invalid-oem, unsupported-center, reference-frame-undeclared, reference-frame-conflict, unsupported-frame, unsupported-time-system, too-few-states, fit-failed, fit-implausible, weather-rows-missing, weather-rows-unselected, weather-rows-invalid:<day>, weather-rows-short:<day>, density-correction-missing, density-correction-unselected, invalid-density-correction, invalid-pvn, provenance-count.

$PCF 1.0.8 (SDS 1.279.0): THEORY (UNSPECIFIED, SGP4XP or AP), FIT (the span rule, hold-out, implausibility bound, BTERM and AGOM priors, WEATHER_HORIZON_DAYS), FORCES (the force model, ATMOSPHERE_MODEL required) and INTEGRATOR (refused); after it, either no further $PCF or one per 'ephemeris' frame in their order, each stating only FIT.DRAG_PRIOR, FIT.SRP_PRIOR and their forms: that object's priors (SPEC 12.8); fields left unset take the documented defaults, but a BTERM prior left unset (FIT.DRAG_PRIOR absent or without a sigma, its form unset) is LOG_NORMAL with median 0.01 m^2/kg and sigma of the log ln 10, where a prior with a sigma and the form GAUSSIAN_SIGNED stays Gaussian on BTERM itself; a set field this module cannot apply is refused by name (configuration-refused), the other tables are other methods'.

inputPorts.description: SPEC 15: daily $SPW rows (DATE, F107_OBS, F107_OBS_CENTER81, AP_AVG, F107_DATA_TYPE), plain records or size-prefixed records end to end, under WEATHER_SOURCE RECORDS: on UTC day d F10.7 is the observed flux of day d - 1, F10.7a the 81-day centered mean and Ap the daily Ap of day d; a later row of a day replaces an earlier one; the rows cover the day before the fit arc through the record's horizon, which the $OCM carries.

The $PVN of each 'ephemeris' frame's source, as its source module writes it: none, or one per 'ephemeris' frame in their order (provenance-count). Every block of that ephemeris writes it on its $OCM field for field with PRODUCER this module and version; an $OEM carries no PROVENANCE of its own.

methods.description: DESIGN 5.1: one Earth SGP4XP $OCM (the theory's own forces; an AP set is refused theory-not-flown:AP, D21) across the burns of its $MNV records, in time order. Each record gives EVENT_START_TIME, the duration (EVENT_END_TIME, or TOTAL_BURN_TIME in s; none: an impulse) and DELTA_VEL_U/V/W (km/s, UVW of the pre-maneuver state: U radial, W along r x v, V = W x U). The post-maneuver set is the inverse of the output map at the burn's centroid, h^-1(x(t_b) + (0, dv), t_b), by fixed-point iteration in equinoctial elements (14); a finite burn scales the eccentricity-vector and plane changes by sinc(dL/2), dL = n D (15). Outputs: the post-maneuver $OCM of every burn (SGP4XP, the input's identity) (epoch the centroid; drag and SRP parameters carried), its $MNV with PRE_EVENT and POST_EVENT states (TEME, osculating elements, BALLISTIC_COEFF = 1/B_eff kg/m^2) and the CHARACTERIZATION from the dv direction, and, when the $PCF OUTPUT names times (EPOCHS, or START_TIME and STOP_TIME), the TEME states across the burns.
